principles: Fail closed before writing signed reviewer evidence
Keep local REVIEW evidence separate from Authority Server receipts
Prefer narrow helper changes over broad lifecycle refactors
drivers: Operators need the real workspace failure reason instead of another currentReviewRound-looking error
Signed reviewer runs must bind to the same workspace that story metadata uses
Authority-required completion must remain receipt-backed and not host-transcript-backed

options.name: A: narrow review_run_start workspace resolver and diagnostic helper
pros: Fixes the actual ctx.root versus cwd correctness risk
Keeps shared lifecycle cwd gates stable
Allows focused regression tests in existing smoke suites
cons: Adds a small amount of duplicated path-shape awareness near context.ts

options.name: B: rebase entire HandlerContext to verified worktree root
pros: Could support more commands under explicit root rebasing later
cons: Larger cross-command behavior change than this defect requires
Higher risk of hidden store/artifact path changes
Would be arbitrary optimization for this story

options.name: C: wording-only change in captureReviewRunSnapshot
cons: Does not fix the real ctx.root/worktree mismatch correctness issue
Would still repair currentReviewRound before knowing a signed snapshot can be created

chosen: A: narrow review_run_start workspace resolver and diagnostic helper
rationale: Choose the narrow resolver because it fixes the real correctness issue without changing unrelated command roots or Authority semantics. It preserves review-only direct REVIEW success when a git-backed snapshot exists, and fails closed before metadata writes when it does not.

preMortem.scenario: The command repairs currentReviewRound in a non-git or unborn-HEAD project and then fails snapshot capture.
preMortem.trigger: ensureCurrentReviewRound remains before snapshot readiness checks.
preMortem.consequence: Story metadata changes even though no signed reviewer run can exist, confusing future diagnosis.
preMortem.mitigation: Order handler logic as story read and phase check, workspace/snapshot readiness, then ensureCurrentReviewRound.

preMortem.scenario: The user runs from the story worktree but passes --root pointing at main.
preMortem.trigger: assertCwdInWorktree checks process.cwd while captureReviewRunSnapshot signs ctx.root.
preMortem.consequence: Reviewer run metadata is persisted under one root while hash evidence binds another root.
preMortem.mitigation: Resolver must fail closed when ctx.root canonical path differs from the verified worktree root.

preMortem.scenario: Authority boundary tests accidentally treat local host text or local reviewRunId as a verified receipt.
preMortem.trigger: Regression coverage asserts only success output and not authority flags.
preMortem.consequence: Local CLI could overclaim productionDone or receiptVerified.
preMortem.mitigation: Run existing Authority smoke suites and add no-overclaim assertions only where directly tied to review_run_start.

preMortem.scenario: Implementation expands into a general worktree rewrite.
preMortem.trigger: Trying to make all story commands rebase roots in one pass.
preMortem.consequence: Large arbitrary refactor with unrelated regressions.
preMortem.mitigation: Limit changes to review_run_start path and pure helper exports needed by tests.
